Cash or points?

THE EARNING STRATEGY

Choose your credit card

Start with the trips you take and the perks you’ll actually use.

You can book award travel with a free loyalty account and enough points. Choose a card for earning or for perks. Check bonus eligibility and spending requirements, and count only benefits you’ll use. Interest can wipe out the value of rewards.
